title: Auth service pods CrashLoopBackOff after config deploy
description: auth-service pods are repeatedly restarting and cycling into CrashLoopBackOff shortly after startup. Login and token-refresh requests are failing cluster-wide because there are no healthy pods left to serve traffic.
